balls.text: a full toss to end the innings and Bardinath pulls the ball high in the air but it falls safely at deep midwicket, the batsmen run the second

shot! Badrinath waits in his crease for a full length ball, Dhoni had set off for the run way before Tanvir delivered, Badrinath meets it with the straight bat and drills the ball down the ground, he's split the gap between long off and long on
full delivery in the block hole, Dhoni tries to hit it down the ground again but gets an inside edge through square leg
another slower ball but this time Dhoni's picked it up early and smashed it over long on for a huge six!
brilliant bowling and terrific running, Tanvir fires the ball into the block hole, Dhoni digs it out towards midwicket, all the fielders on the leg side are in the deep so Dhoni comes back for two

caught! Tanvir bowls the slower delivery angling into the right-hander, Kapugedera gets on the front foot and lofts down the ground, he doesn't get enough on it and hits the ball to Asnodkar who takes an easy catch at long-on
short of a length delivery outside off, Dhoni stays on the back foot and smashes the ball to deep cover, he comes back for the second
bowled full in the block hole outside off, Kapugedera digs it out on the pitch and Dhoni sprints through for a single

Kapugedera backs away and flat-bats a short of a length ball past mid-off who is in the circle, the ball is headed for the boundary but Jadeja speeds across the from long-on and flicks the ball back in, amazing athleticism

Watson pitches a good length ball outside off stump and skids it through, Dhoni swings and tries to hit through the leg side but misses, the ball keeps a little low and hits Akmal on the knee, they run a bye
full ball on off stump, driven towards cover off the front foot

Watson gives Kapugedera another fast short ball but this time it's too high and Bowden signals a no-ball for bowling the second bouncer in the over, that was quick and Kapugedera was beaten for pace as he attempted to hook
bowled full and wide outside off stump, Kapugedera backs away towards leg and slashes, he misses and Bowden signals wide, tough call that
Watson bangs in the fast bouncer outside off stump, Kapugedera begins to wind up to hook but bails out of the shot, Watson hit the pitch very hard
Tanvir gives Dhoni another high full toss, is that the plan? This time Dhoni is prepared and pulls the ball into the gap at deep midwicket for four
Kapugedera backs away to a slower ball and mis-times the slog towards long-on, Chennai need more than the singles that they are getting
another full toss, that was rather high and Dhoni hits it off the back foot towards mid-off
bowled full and fast into the block hole, Kapugedera backs away and drives the ball to mid-off
another slower full toss on middle stump, Dhoni gets cramped for room and drives from his crease towards long-off
bowls the slower ball full and angling into the right-hander, Kapugedera moves towards leg and plays the ball towards midwicket
Kapugedera stays in his crease and square drives a good length ball from outside off to deep point, three runs and a wicket off the over, simply priceless at this stage
Watson pitches on a good length outside off and cuts the ball back into the right-hander, Kapugedera stands in his crease and pushes it to cover
that's quick at 138 kmh in the channel outside off stump, Kapugedera tries to cut but misses
Dhoni hits the slower ball back at the bowler, he hits the ball hard into the ground and Watson leaps up to try and catch it, he gets his hand to it but can't save the single

caught! Big wicket that! Watson gave Raina the full ball outside off, Raina waited on the back foot, got under it and smashed the ball towards long off, he didn't get enough distance this time and Jadeja took a simple catch on the boundary, Warne is pumped
banged in short around off stump, Dhoni waits on the back foot and pulls the ball to deep midwicket
Tanvir pitches the ball short of a length and angles it into the right-hander form round the wicket, Dhoni pulls towards deep midwicket
another one in the block hole outside off, Raina pushes the ball towards cover
smashed! Raina's on a roll here, he clears his front foot out of the way and drives a full ball back past the bowler for four, that was nearly in the block hole but Raina connected splendidly
Raina flicks the ball off the pads towards long leg
lovely shot! Tanvir nearly finds the block hole but Raina punches the ball with such grace towards long-off, they runs quickly between the wickets and come back for the second
he starts off with a slower full toss outside off stump, Raina is foxed and gets an edge that bounces through to the keeper
Raina gets down on one knee and pulls a flat ball from off stump towards deep midwicket, that's the end of Warne's spell, he's not had much of an impact today
bowled full outside of stump, Raina drives off the front foot but finds the fielder at cover
he moves back in his crease and pulls the ball towards deep square leg
he's hammered him! Dhoni winds up with a massive back lift, he gets under a full ball and lofts it over long-on, super power in the shot
Dhoni comes down the track, gets beaten in the flight, and defends
Dhoni waits in his crease and cuts the straighter ball towards point, Warne's keeping it flat
Raina backs away towards leg and pulls the ball towards wide long-on, Dhoni hurtles between the wickets and calls Raina back for the second
Trivedi replies with the slower short ball outside off stump, Raina got into position to early and then had to wait an eternity for the ball to reach him, he lets it go
caught! No it's six! Raina moves back to a short ball and pulls the ball towards deep square leg, it did not come off the middle but he got enough on it to barely clear Jadeja on the boundary
Dhoni pushes the ball towards cover for another single
the slower ball on the stumps, Raina makes room and pulls the ball towards long-on to bring up Chennai's hundred
short and wide outside off stump, Raina moves back and cuts the ball powerfully towards deep point where Watson runs and dives to his right to save the boundary
Raina moves back and punches the flat ball towards wide mid-off for one, what a spell Yusuf has bowled, 3 for 22 off four overs, he's kept Rajasthan in this game
bowled flat and straight, Dhoni comes forward and pushes towards long-on

caught! But two fielders are hurt! Morkel tries to go over deep midwicket again top-edges a flat and fast ball on middle and off, the ball goes in the air behind the wicketkeeper, Akmal turns around and goes for the catch, Kaif also runs in from short fine leg, Akmal takes the catch but then Kaif slides and crashes into Akmal's knees rugby style, Akmal did superbly to hold on to it because the impact was hard, both fielders lie on the ground

has he cleared the boundary? Only just! Morkel clears his front foot out of the way and pulls the ball high over deep midwicket, Watson's on the boundary and he jumps high and gets fingertips to it as the ball flies over the boundary
Yusuf bowls a fast ball on leg and middle, Morkel pushes towards cover, it was a rather inside out shot
Yusuf keeps it flat and straight, Morkel stays in his crease and pulls towards deep square leg
Morkel steps forward and drives the full and flat ball hard towards long-off
this time it's called wide, Warne had fired another one down leg side, this one might have clipped the thigh pad
Warne bowls a flatter ball way down leg side, Koertzen lets it go, very strange that
Albie's hit a massive one! He cleared his front foot out of the way to create a lot of room and absolutely smashed Warne into the stands at deep midwicket, sheer power
Raina stays in his crease and tries to hit a flat ball straight down the ground, he slices it in the air towards long-off on the first bounce
pulled off the back foot to deep square leg for a single
Morkel steps out of his crease but pushes towards cover once he realises he isn't to the pitch of the ball
Morkel punches the ball towards long-on, Yusuf runs to his right and tries to cut it off but Raina is in his way and the ball goes past him
pushed towards short third man off the back foot, just one run off the over so far, can Yusuf finish well?
tight line and length from Yusuf, Morkel defends back to the bowler
Morkel tries to flick a full ball on the leg side but misses and he gets hit on the pad, Bowden says not out for it pitched outside leg
Morkel moves back and defends towards the bowler
Raina backs away but Yusuf follows him and cramps him for room, Raina gets an inside edge on the leg side, he sprints a dangerous single but it's well run in the end
Raina steps out of his crease and pulls the ball to deep square leg, lovely batting, expensive over from Warne
Raina moves back and pulls the flatter ball towards deep midwicket for two more
superb strike! Raina strides forward, gets to the pitch of the ball and cudgels the ball flat and far over  wide long-on, he didn't get height on it but the distance is what counts
bowled flatter and straighter, that's the one that skids on to the batsman, Raina defends back to the bowler
shorter and wider outside the off stump, Raina cuts hard off the back foot to Trivedi at short third man
Raina waits in his crease and guides the ball towards third man by opening the face, he's batting so fluently

Akmal's missed a stumping! But no he's caught it! Parthiv charges down the pitch and Yusuf fires in a flat and fast ball, Parthiv decides to run the ball towards third man but gets an edge to Akmal who fumbles the catch initially but then dives to his right to take the rebound, sharp effort, and I thought he had missed a stumping initially!
shot! Parthiv clears his front foot out of the way to make room and slogs a fuller and flatter ball over deep midwicket, he's hit it in the gap in the deep
Raina nudges the ball off his pads for a single
this time Parthiv makes a bit off room and lofts the ball over the off side
bowled flat and full on middle stump, Parthiv backs away but doesn't have enough space to hit the ball over the leg side, he plays it back to the bowler
Yusuf bowls flat and pitches outside leg stump, Raina flicks the ball off his pads behind square
he gives it more air this time outside off, Raina moves forward and drives the ball along the ground towards long-on, he got to the pitch of that one nicely
tossed up a bit more on off and middle, Parthiv comes forward and swings the ball to deep midwicket
flatter and shorter ball, Raina moves back and pulls through square leg
Parthiv tries to sweep from outside the line of off stump, he misses and gets hit on the pad, they run a leg bye towards the off side
bowled flatter, fuller and straighter, Raina moves forward and drives the ball hard towards long-on, wristy shot
Parthiv gets his front foot a long way across, outside the line of off stump, and sweeps to deep square leg
the slower off cutter to end the over, Parthiv hits it off the back foot with a flat bat towards long-on
Patel charges down the track and smashes the ball to Yusuf at mid-off who fields superbly and throws so quickly at the keepers end that Parthiv hurries back into his crease
clever shot! Raina stays in his crease, gets under the short ball as it bounces across him and then chips the ball down to third man, much like those shots Tendulkar played in Australia against Lee
slower ball on middle and leg, Parthiv works the ball off the back foot behind square for one
this time Parthiv charges and pulls the short ball through wide mid-on for four, the length was too short and the fact that the ball didn't bounce that much gave  Parthiv a lot of time
Parthiv charges Trivedi and mis-hits the attempted pull over wide mid-on, Trivedi saw him coming and shortened his length
the length is a bit short from Pathan and Patel moves forward and across and nudges the ball towards midwicket
Raina gets off the mark by flicking a flat ball off the front foot through square leg
played off the pads behind square for a single
Parthiv moves across his stumps and tries to work the ball on the leg side, he misses and gets hit below the knee roll in front of the stumps, that looks rather out but Koertzen is unmoved

the change has worked! Vidyut charges Yusuf and tries to pull a flat and fast ball over deep midwicket, he doesn't time it well and Jadeja sprints in from the boundary and dives forward to take a low and well-judged catch with both hands, he is a terrific fielder is Ravindra Jadeja
bowled flat through the air outside off, played off the front foot  to point

Parthiv charges yet again and flat-bats a short of a length delivery back over the bowler's head, he hasn't timed it well though and Yusuf Pathan chases the ball from mid-off and gets to it before Tanvir does from mid-on
Parthiv moves across his stumps and nudges a short of a length delivery towards fine leg, Trivedi is the fielder and the throw to Akmal is poor
tighter line and length on middle and off, Parthiv defends back to the bowler

ho ho! Parthiv charges this time and Munaf counters with a short ball, there's a bit of width though and Parthiv uses it to slash hard, extremely hard, he gets under the ball and the top edge flies down to the third man boundary
he tries! He takes two steps down the track but seeing that Munaf had pitched the ball short, he waits for the ball to reach him and then opens the face to play it to third man
good length delivery around off and middle stump, Parthiv waits for it and pushes the ball towards third man for another single, he's opening the face nicely and picking off the runs in that region

he's going for broke! Vidyut backs away towards leg again to make room to hit over the off side, Watson counters with a short ball and Vidyut throws his bat at it really hard, the ball hits the top edge and carries all the way over the keeper's head for a six!
shot boy! Vidyut skips down the track and makes room to hit the ball high over cover, the outfield is on the slower side so Asnodkar has time to run to his left in the deep and save the boundary
Akmal's saved a boundary there, Vidyut got a thick inside edge that ran to Akmal's right but he was quick to dive across and cut it off, Vidyut was trying to guide the ball to third man
Vidyut backs away towards leg stump to make room, Watson pitches short and the room allows Vidyut to free his arms and launch the ball over cover, lovely improvisation
Watson tests Vidyut again with the bouncer, he tries to pull but gets beaten for pace
Watson hits Parthiv on the pad with a good length ball that slants across the left-hander, that pitched outside leg stump though so Koertzen says not out
Vidyut charges once again but this time the length is a bit shorter from Munaf, he tries to pull but mis-hits it back towards the bowler, the Chennai openers are showing intent
Parthiv moves back and opens the face of the bat to guide a length ball towards third man
Vidyut charges down the pitch and drives a length ball powerfully towards wide mid-off, Pathan moves quickly to his right and dives to cut off the four, excellent save
Parthiv waits on the back foot and dabs the short of a length ball towards point
Vidyut steps forward to a length ball and punches towards mid-off again, this time he calls for the single and sprints through
tight line and length on middle and off, pushed towards mid-off on the front foot

Parthiv's taken him on! It's a length ball from Watson around off stump, Parthiv takes a step forward and lofts the ball over cover, he may not have timed it perfectly but the ball still rolls for four
another sharp short ball and this time Parthiv decides that he better duck under this one
Watson tests Vidyut with the short ball and he goes for the hook, he hasn't connected properly and the ball falls well short of Jadeja at long leg, Vidyut was off balance as he played the shot
good length delivery pitches on middle and off stump, Vidyut gets behind the line on the back foot and defends towards point
the line is a bit straight from Watson and Parthiv jumps across his stumps and flicks the ball off his pads down towards fine leg
hits a good length around off stump and angles across the left-hander, Parthiv leans forward and drives the ball on the up towards mid-off
once again Parthiv works the ball towards fine leg off his pads, just the single this time
shot! Parthiv moves across his stumps early and creates the room to use the angle into him, he whips the ball off his pads towards fine leg, the fielder on the boudnary is square
a bit too full outside off and Parthiv leans into an elegant square drive, he times it well but can't beat the fielder at point
once again Parthiv shoulders arms, Tanvir's keeping it on a good length outside off
Tanvir pitches the ball on a good length and seams the ball away from the left-hander, Parthiv lets it go, a bit of bounce there for Tanvir
Tanvir swings the ball down leg side this time, chennai are away with a wide
Tanvir swings the full ball into Parthiv from over the wicket, Pathriv strides forward and across and gets hit flush on the pad, that's a close shout for lbw but Bowden says not out

Rajasthan have won! What a finish! Tanvir stays in his crease and pulls a short of a length delivery through wide mid-on, Warne was already half-way down the pitch by the time he made contact with the ball, the players run on to the field and mob their captain Warne and their best bowler Tanvir, who's been a hero with the bat today

Balaji bowls a full toss angling into the left-hander, Tanvir uses the angle into him and flicks towards long leg, Warne was setting off even before the bowler had delivered, they run two, the scores are level
Warne reaches out for a full ball and squeezes it towards point for a single
what has he done! Balaji has bowled a wide outside off stump, Tanvir lets it go and Parthiv fails to collect cleanly and the batsmen run, that's two runs without a legal delivery being bowled
Warne steps down the track and throws his bat at a low full toss outside off, he hits it through cover for one
lovely! Balaji's bowled a yorker outside off stump, Warne tries to dig it out but misses, he was looking to smash it through cover
a low full toss and Tanvir comes forward and chips the ball down to long on for just the single

Warney! He backs away to a good length ball and smacks it with terrific hand-eye co-ordination through covers for four, superb placement for there was a fielder in the deep but the ball was hit to his right
Ntini fires in another full toss and Tanvir mis-hits the pull towards long on, Badrinath runs in from the boundary but the ball falls short of him
too full from Ntini, Tanvir drives the ball off his pads towards wide long on where Badrinath sprints to his left and dives to ave the four, terrific effort
another full toss and Warne can only flick it towards deep square leg, he could have done more with that you feel
Ntini delivers a full toss which Tanvir drives towards long-on, just the single once again
Warne backs away to a full length delivery and drives the ball inside out through extra cover, Badrinath fields and the batsmen run only a single

a full ball homes into Warne's pads, he tries to flick and loses balance, the ball hist the pad and goes to short fine leg, Gony misses the stumps at the batsman's end of else Tanvir might have been struggling
Tanvir plays the ball off his pads towards midwicket for one
Morkel strays down leg side and that is a wide

Raina you beauty! A direct hit runs out Yusuf! Warne pushed the full ball firmly to point and set off for the single, Yusuf responded and ran at top speed, Raina collected cleanly, he had one stump to aim at and he threw it down with supreme precision, Yusuf was yards out

Chennai have missed a golden chance! Yusuf clears his front foot out of the way and tries to slog down the ground, he gets an inside edge behind square and they run the single, Yusuf wants the second and sets off, Warne sends him back but Yusuf is a long way down when the throw comes to Parthiv, Yusuf turns and runs straight back down the middle of the pitch, obscuring Parthiv's vision, Morkel didn't get back to the stumps and couldn't collect Parthiv's throw
Warne comes down the pitch and swats a low full toss through cover for a single, Yusuf wants the second but Warne doesn't
full ball on the stumps, Yusuf clears his front foot out of the way and slogs to deep midwicket, Morkel has over-stepped, a criminal offence in such a situation, free hit coming up

what has he done? Jadeja backs away towards leg stump and tries to pull a short ball, the delivery hurries on to him and he mis-hits it tamely towards mid-on where Kapugedera runs to his left and takes a simple catch, that was an immature shot
caught! Another twist! Kaif steps out of his crease, Murali bowls the flat doosra and Kaif prods tamely at the ball, it hits the splice of the bat and goes straight to Dhoni at cover, simple catch
Yusuf strides forward and hits the flat delivery towards deep midwicket
Murali bowls the full toss this time and Yusuf brings up his fifty by hoisting the ball over deep midwicket, fantastic innings, two catches dropped but he made the chances count!
Kaif steps down once again and drives towards long-on
flat and fast from Murali, defended on the back foot
Kaif! He steps down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts Murali cleanly over deep midwicket for six, he cleared the boundary comfortably
Balaji ends the over with a short ball, Yusuf tries to pull but misses

that's a high full toss and Yusuf mis-hits the pull in the air but the ball falls safely at midwicket, Yusuf comes back for second and makes his ground before Parthiv collects Ntini's flat throw and whips off the bails
that's a terrible ball, a friendly full toss and Yusuf helps himself to six by smashing it over long off, powerful shot but the delivery was awful from Balaji
driven firmly off the front foot towards cover

Yusuf backs away to a full toss and smashes the ball over the stumps at the bowler's end, the ball races towards the boundary, the fielder from long off runs to his right and dives full length to pull the ball back in, the ball rolls away from the fielder and Gony, who had run from long on, fails to stop it from touching the boundary
Kaif strides forward to a good length ball which angles into the right hander, he opens the face and guides the ball to third man
Kaif takes a step out of his crease, he isn't to the pitch of the ball and defends towards cover point
defended on the back foot towards the leg side
Kaif strides forward and checks his off drive but manages to place it through the in-field, Ntini runs from long off to his left and fields
Pathan winds up with a big back lift and flicks a full length ball through midwicket for a single
bowled flat on middle and leg, flicked off the pads towards square leg

bowled him! Watson comes down the track to Murali but yorks himself by getting too close to the ball, the ball squeezes under the bat and hits leg stump, this is a huge wicket and Murali's broken through the pair of Rajasthan's most dangerous batsmen
Gony ends his spell with a yorker, Watson leans across and nudges the ball towards square leg
Watson tries to play his late cut but Gony gets the ball to lift off a good length and beat the bat
driven firmly off the front foot towards mid-off for a single
the slower ball this time, Yusuf pushes the ball towards midwicket

dropped again but it was a tough chance, Yusuf tries to pull a short of a length ball from outside off and flat-bats it towards Gony's left, the ball is traveling quickly and bounces off Gony's outstretched hand, those either stick or they don't
Watson leans forward to a fuller length ball and flicks through midwicket, he's timed it superbly and Ntini sprints across the boundary's edge and dives and pulls the ball back in
this is bigger! Yusuf charges again and uses all his muscle to swing the bat with a mighty follow through, he connects well and the ball flies into the first tier at long on, simply tremendous
that is a mammoth hit! Yusuf skips down the track, gets to the pitch of a flighted delivery and smashes it far over wide long-on, that ball flew into the first tier
Watson leans forward and flicks a full ball through square leg for a single
Yusuf yorks himself as he charges Murali and gets an inside edge on to the pad, they run a single to the off side
Yusuf tries to cut off the back foot but gets beaten by the doosra outside off stump
bowled flat through the air outside off, played off the back foot towards cover
full ball wide outside off stump, the batsman swings and misses, Koertzen decides to let it go
excellent ball in the block hole, driven to long on for a single
Yusuf backs away to a full toss an slices it through cover point for th single
Morkel delivers a full ball in the block hole outside off stump, Yusuf swings and misses, excellent ball, Yusuf took a step down the pitch after he missed, was he looking for the single?

that's nearly caught! Short of a length outside off stump, Yusuf waits on the back foot and cuts the ball in the air towards third man, Gony tries to catch it but the ball falls just short, Morkel had overstepped so there's a free hit coming up
fuller length on middle add leg, Watson moves back and flicks off his pads for a single
Yusuf tries to smash Morkel down the ground but gets an inside edge on to pad, you feel he's either going to smack a few into the crowd or get out
flicked off the pads to deep midwicket where Gony does the fielding
driven towards long on for a single
defended on the front foot towards the off side

Raina's dropped it! Yusuf went after Murali and tried to loft him over deep midwicket, he hit it extremely high between midwicket and mid-on, Raina ran to his left from midwicket to try and get under the steepler, he fumbles the first attempt, barely manages to hold on on the second but as his hands hit the ground the ball falls out
pushed towards midwicket off the front foot
Yusuf tries to sweep Murali and gets hit low on the front pad in front of middle, that was close but perhaps missing leg
deft, extremely deft, Watson waits in his crease and at the last moment opens the face of the bat to run the ball between the keeper and short third man, superb touch
a length delivery outside off stump and Yusuf drives powerfully off the front foot towards mid-off and runs the quick single
too short once again and Yusuf has sent the ball scorching through midwicket with a pull off the front foot, Murali scampers to his left in the deep but has no chance
full toss and Yusuf hits it hard towards Balaji who gets down low and fields to his left, well done
Yusuf steps down the track and pulls a short of a length delivery powerfully through deep square leg for four, that was more of a swat really, but hit with a lot of power
Watson stays in his crease, waits for the good length ball to angle into him and chops it towards third man with an open face
short of a length delivery angles into the right-hander after pitching around off, defended off the back foot
Yusuf tries to get under a length ball and lofts it high over mid-on, he hasn't connected properly and the ball plugs in the out field
full length on off stump, Watson opens the face late to play the ball towards third man
Watson moves forward and across and flicks a fuller length ball elegantly through midwicket for four, lovely shot
fired down leg side this time, Bowden signals wide

caught! Or is it? Dhoni and Bowden exchange words, Morkel bangs in another short ball and Yusuf tries to pull, he misses and the ball smacks the helmet and lobs up to Parthiv who takes the catch, Chennai are sure they've got a wicket but Bowden is unmoved, curiously Bowden forgot to signal a leg bye
this time Morkel bangs in the bouncer, it's too high and Bowden signals wide
Morkel gets the ball to lift from just short of a length, Yusuf came forward to defend and the ball got big on him
that's short and wide outside off stump, Watson stays on his crease and whacks the ball with a flat bat straight past the bowler for four, tremendous power
short length again and Watson pulls off the front foot towards deep backward square leg
tight line and length around off stump, defended off the back foot to the bowler
Balahji drops a little short and Yusuf moves on to the back foot to pull through midwicket
Pathan strides forward to a good length ball outside off and drives towards point
he hits a good length and zips the ball though outside off stump, Pathan moves forward and plays a half-drive, he gets beaten
137.1kph, tapped to point and they think of one, direct hit misses but he might have been in, they think of running on the overthrow but another direct hit is missed, the ball is flying all over now
on the pads and worked away towards square leg

that's another! this is a wonderful piece of inspiration from Ntini, gets the direct hit and Akmal has to go, pushes to mid-on and they take off, that was pretty suicidal, Ntini swoops down and flings one in, smashes the stumps and Akmal is short, no need to refer that to the third umpire as well
short of a length, angled into the body, tries to flick it away but manages a legbye to the off side, quick single
short ball, weaves out of the way, ducks under it too

strikes first ball, full and wide, the plan has worked, he's slashed straight to point and Raina has gobbled that up, it was pretty clear that they were planning a wide line to him and Albie has struck off his first ball, Chennai are on a high
steered to third man, sensibly done and retains strike

full and wide again, slower ball this time, the plan seems to be to get him to slash, straight to mid-off and Akmal thinks of a run, a direct hit would have been trouble but Murali misses, Akmal could have been in a spot there
too wide again, that was full, cracked straight to Raina at point, can't find the gap
walks down the track, bit towards leg stump, driven down the ground, past the bowler, not that well timed and they get a single
too short and too wide, slashed had but there's a fielder at deep point, needs to be straighter Gony
steered his bat to third man, Vidyut lets out a dive but they're back for two, Dhoni isn't happy with that fielding effort, he didn't want more than a single there
142.7kph, full and outside off, slashed but that's missed the outside edge
cheeky, he's walked across the stumps and whipped that past short fine leg for four, he knew both the fine leg and square leg were in the circle and chose his shot well
beaten outside off, full ball that, tries to drive but that beats the outside edge, bit of seam movement there
143.1kph, full outside off, he's chancing his arm here, slicing it towards third man, along the ground that time
he's a pocket-dynamo Asnodkar, backs off a bit, sees the width and lashed that over the cover field, that's classic Kalu, audacious but effective, one-bounce four that
143.9kph, patted to the off side, they think of a quick one but decide against it
